## Football effect

Butler played 13 defensive snaps after Poyer's and Talib's removals and 20 on the kicking game with no tackle recorded before the injury was logged at the end of Indianapolis's last touchdown drive at 1:01 of the fourth quarter; he was removed and Chris Prosinski took his place by the chart's order, the kernel's replacement under the frozen chart with no pause recorded; Jacksonville's two remaining snaps were kneel-downs. The hold is the independent medical process's and no football finding attaches to it. On the projection he misses the San Diego week; his availability follows the independent process's communication, not the projection. The cornerback order for Week 4 is Stone's decision after the Monday exams; the projection by itself requires no roster decision.
